name: Dev Tools
description: A lightweight dev toolset under 200KB — instant to use. Sandboxed and offline with zero network access. High-frequency tools for crypto, encoding, text, data conversion, formatting, time, networking and image generation; inputs and options are remembered and sync seamlessly across devices via DBX.

versions.releaseNotes: Initial release: 10 pure-frontend workbench tools (password, QR code, barcode, hash, UUID, Base64, JWT parser, RMB uppercase, URL codec, image ⇄ Base64).
Initial release with 10 tools: password, QR code, barcode, hash, UUID, Base64, JWT parser, RMB uppercase, URL codec and image ⇄ Base64.

26 tools: password/ID/lorem/QR/barcode generators, Base64/URL/escape/image codecs, hash & HMAC, JWT decode & sign, AES, RMB uppercase, JSON formatter, text diff, case/line/invisible-char/mojibake tools, timestamp & date calc, file size, number base, color & contrast, chmod.

40 tools: password/ID/lorem/QR/barcode/RSA/TOTP/placeholder generators, Base64/32/58/URL/escape/punycode/quoted-printable/data-URI/image codecs, image compressor, hash & HMAC & CRC32, JWT decode & sign, AES, certificate decoder, RMB uppercase, JSON formatter, text diff, regex tester, case/line/invisible-char/mojibake tools, timestamp & date calc & duration, cron expression, SQL IN builder, Unicode inspector, file size, number base, semver, IP calculator, color & contrast & CMYK, chmod.

Navigation overhaul: one Dev Tools workbench entry with an in-plugin sidebar — home, search with clear button, favorites, recently used and a collapsible all-tools group; the sidebar itself collapses to an icon rail. Favorites are pinned to a dedicated home section and reorderable by drag-and-drop in both places, with proper drag ghosts and grip affordances. Quick-fav stars on every tool row including search results, clear-recent action, and a hand-drawn lucide-style SVG icon set replacing emoji. Still ~120KB, fully offline.

Two new tools (42 total, ~150KB): HTTP helper (raw headers ⇄ JSON + status code/header reference) and a CSS generator (gradients, box-shadow, live preview). Time tool gains timezone conversion with bare-offset input (+8, UTC+8) and a local-zone shortcut; color gains harmony palettes; case converter gains URL slugs; ID generator gains deterministic UUID v5/v3. UI: 23 consolidated category chips capped at two rows, collapsible all-tools grids, privacy switch for recents, favorites empty-state card, persisted typewriter toggle, ⌘K/Ctrl+K search focus.

Bug fix: JSON formatter, JWT inspector and header converter no longer corrupt integers beyond 2^53-1 (e.g. snowflake IDs) — number literals round-trip exactly as written. New: collapsed icon rail opens floating panels — favorites (drag-reorderable), recents, and an all-tools grid with its own search box (autofocus, Enter jumps to the first hit). Home header shows the plugin version badge; typewriter pill adopts the accent color; star hover colors now match between sidebar and home.

新增：Nginx / XML / YAML 三个格式化工具（语法高亮、输出可另存为文件），首页「格式化」分类，搜索与分类筛选状态在返回首页后保留。修复：身份证工具「指定日期」改为定宽 YYYY-MM-DD 输入并内联校验。 | New: Nginx, XML and YAML formatters with syntax highlighting and save-to-file; a Formatter category; the home search query and category filter now persist when returning from a tool. Fix: CN ID Card exact-date input is a fixed-width YYYY-MM-DD field with inline validation.

修复：Cron 的 N/step 步长解析（如 0/2 不再退化为整点），非法 ?/N 会被拒绝。新增：下次执行条数可自定义并记忆；首页 GitHub 图标加入动画（空闲微摆 + 悬停变色），页脚新增开源反馈入口，复制链接改为跟随点击位置的浮层提示。 | Fix: cron N/step atoms (e.g. 0/2) no longer degrade to the bare start value, and invalid ?/N is rejected. New: configurable next-runs count (persisted); animated GitHub icon with idle tail-flick and brand-teal hover, plus a footer invite for issues/PRs/stars; copy confirmation is now a floating chip at the click point.

修复：部分机器首页工具网格只显示 2 列且右侧留白（布局回归问题）；页脚 GitHub 入口点击后没有复制提示——浮层在空间不足时改为显示在控件上方，沙箱内复制失败时直接展示链接。视觉：收藏星标与收藏空状态图标改用主题色。 | Fix: on some machines the home grid shrank to 2 columns with dead space on the right (layout regression); the footer GitHub link gave no copy feedback — the chip now flips above the control when space is tight and shows the URL itself when copying is unavailable in the sandbox. Visual: favorite stars and the favorites empty-state now use the theme color.

zh-CN.name: Dev 工具集
zh-CN.description: 不到 200KB 的轻量开发者工具集，即开即用。沙箱离线运行，零网络权限。涵盖加解密、编解码、文本处理、数据转换、格式化、时间计算、网络运维、图像生成等众多高频工具；参数自动记忆，配置可随 DBX 跨端无缝同步。
